Description: Economics per actor for the reference house (T-14, decision 0028), job model of decision 0020 (Type 1 = batch LLM priced per token, served first; Type 2 = research simulations as filler, per server-hour) on datacenter-licensed hardware only (decision 0027). Variant economics: the scored case figures (case break-even) are unchanged and come from config/reference-house.json. Prices are per 1 kW server-hour (one server-hour = 1 kWh electricity), see docs/model/economics.md.

Type2FillRate.source: decision 0020 (must-have 1 table): Type 2 arrivals are 'unlimited jobs' (case-permitted), i.e. every leftover heat-led hour is sold; the sourced fill rate 0.35 (range 0.2-0.6, docs/research/filler-demand.md section 6) is the sensitivity in Levers.Type2FillRates and Grid.Type2FillRates

Type1ShareOfOfferedHours.source: TODO(source): no sourced Type 1 (batch LLM) volume per house (decision 0020: 'unlimited jobs', no sourced volume yet); 0 in the base case, swept in the lever table and reported as the required Type 1 share

Type1PriceChfPerMillionTokens.source: docs/research/profitability-inputs.md section 2 and docs/jobs/llm-summary.md: Mistral Ministral 3 8B list price USD 0.15 per 1M input and output tokens x 0.8402 CHF/USD (ai-llm-mistral-ministral3-8b, high); decision 0020 expects the batch-API level (-50 %, CHF 0.063) unless fixed contracts, swept in Levers.Type1PricesChfPerMillionTokens

WearReplacementSharePerYear.source: TODO(source): failure and replacement cost as a share of the purchase price per year comes from T-35 (refurbished hardware); 0 is an optimistic placeholder

Type2PriceChfPerServerHour.source: decisions 0018/0020 and docs/research/computing-price.md section 5: pinned CHF 0.66 per server-hour

NotPermittedHardware.Reason: not permitted (licence): NVIDIA GeForce driver licence v. 25 Feb 2025 section 2.8, 'not licensed for datacenter deployment' (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/geforce-license, opened 2026-11-21, data/raw/market pc-licence-geforce-no-datacenter); a DigitalHeat-operated fleet counts as such (decision 0027)

Levers.Source: lever axes for the comparison table (not measured values): 4 servers = draft presentation scenario (T-06), 1 server = sized for the hot-water base load (competitors.md lesson 1); Type 1 shares are a sweep because Type 1 demand is TODO(source); Type 1 token prices = batch-API level 0.063 and list 0.126 CHF per 1M tokens (Ministral 3 8B); Type 2 fill rates = unlimited jobs (decision 0020) and the sourced 0.35 (filler-demand.md section 6)

Grid.Source: chart axes (not measured values): Type 2 price 0-3 CHF covers the pinned 0.66 and the L4 market range 0.85-2.20 (filler-demand.md); electricity 0.10-0.50 covers Swiss spot 0.10 to retail 0.33 (energy-prices.csv); Type 2 fill rates = filler-demand.md low/base/high and unlimited jobs; Type 1 at the base token price Type1PriceChfPerMillionTokens

RequiredType1ShareStep.source: numerical resolution of the required Type 1 share search (not a measured value)
